notes.title: Updated Demo Release and Kickstarter
notes.content: [p]The Kickstarter for Paradox Protocol is live now and can be found at;[/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dan96iel/paradox-protocol/description"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dan96iel/paradox-protocol/description[/url][/p][p]Any support, interest and/or feedback would be greatly appreciated at this key stage of development.[/p][p][/p][p]Following several major issues that came to my attention from player feedback and from bugs I found myself when testing a large update to the demo has been made.[/p][p][/p][p]Collisions at the centre of the map have been corrected so players no longer fall through the world[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed a bug where players could take an artifact but it would not place it in their inventory.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed the enemy attack range so now they will do an AOE at the correct location and will no longer kill you over long distances[/p][p][/p][p]Tutorial showing core gameplay loop and controls has been added, further expansion to this demo will be added to full version of the game around launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Pause menu has been added to the demo and included within this is a guidebook that explains important features and has a page displaying keybindings.[/p][p][/p][p]Flashlight is provided when the player spawns due to a known issue with the hotbar drag and drop system that is currently being corrected ready for launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Corrections made to the attenuation of enemy steps so players should now no longer be able to hear certain enemies across large distances[/p][p][/p][p]Overhaul to AI tasks currently underway in preparation for launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally I just want to say a HUGE thank you to everyone who has already wishlisted or shown interest in Paradox Protocol and I will update again soon with further information on launch and content/roadmap following release[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
